conditions.notes: Open-circuit back-EMF fundamental at the 325 V corner speed 3625 rpm, expressed from the specsheet back-EMF constant Ke = 51 V line-line peak per 1000 rpm (printed in both conventions; 51/sqrt(2) = 36 V ph-ph rms): E_ph_pk = (Ke/sqrt(3)) * n/1000.

source_file: Tecnotion Torque QTR 105 series specsheet Ver. 2.0 (2021), column QTR-A-105-25 winding N
provenance_note: Unit conversion of the specsheet constant, NOT an independent measurement: the motor TOML psi_f = 0.028118 Wb is DERIVED from this same Ke (psi_f = [Ke/(1000*2*pi/60)]/(sqrt(3)*n_p)), so backemf_fundamental here equals psi_f*n_p*omega by construction. derived_params arms the calibration circularity guard (REQ-0819): fitting psi_f (or interderivable B_rem) against this dataset is an echo, not a calibration, and is refused. Tolerance 10% per sheet remark 'All specifications +-10%'.
